First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Easy, gentle on hills.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the RideTheCov Wednesday Series group ride

RideTheCov Wednesday Series is a social group ride in Covington, KY. It rolls every other Wednesday at 6:00 pm from MainStrasse Village, Goose Girl Fountain.

Short, easy rides through the river cities to get people on bikes. A quick safety check and tire pump before rolling. Group riding basics explained at the start. Helmets suggested.
